# Header-action pop-outs open at the 480×360 fallback size

## Context

I found this while answering RA-2 of Euclid's review of #19596, which asks for exact-head receipts for #19583's AC-5. Four Workstation Neural Link cases pass at `5ccdb192d6^` and fail from `5ccdb192d6` (#19559, merged 2026-10-10 17:00Z) on. I ran them locally on macOS, headless, with `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` set:

| Spec › case | At `5ccdb192d6` and after |
|---|---|
| `WorkstationNL` › "pop-out uses the Group cursor to return and replay the same live pane" | vessel dims `{width: 480, height: 360}`; expected the pane's `{355, 519}` |
| `WorkstationNativeTitlebarDragNL` › "a pane popped out through the header action is born at the OUTER size of the tabs node it left" | frame 480×360; expected the node's 425×635 |
| `WorkstationNativePopupOverPopupNL` › "an enlarged popup updates its drop zones before another popup transfers into the newly exposed area" | "the target is substantially wider" fails; the target is 480×360 |
| `WorkstationNativePopupOverPopupNL` › "resizing an already-hovered popup refreshes its drop zones without leaving the target" | same |

Hosted CI never ran these. Its e2e job sets no `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT`, so it deselects every Brain-gated spec; Euclid's review counted 42 of 144 files selected.

## The Problem

Every header-action pop-out opens at the fixed 480×360 fallback instead of the footprint of the pane it leaves. #19559's own commit records the operator's contract for the header pop-out: "the popup's OUTER size equals the widget's".

## The Architectural Reality

- `HeaderActions#handleDockPopOutAction` measures the pane's tabs node (`measureDockPaneRect(tabContainer)`) and passes the result only as `proxyRect` (`src/dashboard/dock/plugin/HeaderActions.mjs:225–234`).
- Before #19559, `VesselWorkspace#openTearOutVessel` sized from `proxyRect`. Since #19559, it sizes from `sourceRect` alone, through `Placement.resolveVesselSize` (`pinned ?? sourceRect ?? fallback`), and "a null source reaches the helper's fallback" (#19559's commit).
- `TearOut` forwards `data.sourceRect ?? null` (`src/dashboard/dock/window/TearOut.mjs:840`). The drag path supplies that rect from the sort zone's measurement at drag arming. The header path supplies none.
- Design authority:
  - #19559's commit message, quoted above.
  - #19375's witness ("born at the OUTER size of the tabs node it left").
  - #19450's design: a torn-out window keeps the widget's size, clamped to the screen, with a floor of 320×240.

## The Fix

`handleDockPopOutAction` also passes its measurement as `sourceRect`. The header path then takes the same sizing route as the drag path: the measured footprint, clamped and floored by `resolveVesselSize`. The header path measures the tabs node, the footprint #19375 asserts; the drag path measures the card body. Each path keeps its own measurement.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The four cases above pass again (local, `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` set).
- [x] A unit test pins that the header action admits its measured rect as `sourceRect`. Without the fix it fails.
- [x] The drag path's sizing witnesses from #19559 stay green: `DockVesselSize`, `DockTabSortZone`, `DockTearOut`, and `WorkstationHumanPopupOverlapNL`.

The evidence is in #19598, merged as `3ec6e0b945` with Emmy's approval:
- The four cases and `WorkstationHumanPopupOverlapNL` pass 9/9 locally at `7076eff422`.
- `DockWorkspace.spec` › "…carries the measured rect" fails without the fix.
- The full unit suite passes: 4903 tests, 2 skipped.

## Out of Scope

- Hosted CI's deselection of Brain-gated specs. I'm recording it as a defect-note.
- `WorkstationTabDragLabelOverlapNL`'s red. It is a pre-existing timing flake in its positive control: 2/10 before #19559, 3/10 on `dev`.
